content: <input type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment"> is the pragmatic mobile camera-capture pattern: opens the native camera directly on mobile (rear camera via capture=environment), gracefully degrades to a normal file picker on desktop, and needs zero extra permissions/libraries. getUserMedia()-based custom camera UI (react-webcam et al.) gives more control (live preview, multi-shot before upload) but requires a secure context and is NOT supported in non-Safari browsers on iOS (WebKit-only restriction), a real risk for a mixed-device field team.
